answer: Work slots are scarce: to claim one, an agent burns a 60 POA deposit and holds it for 20 epochs, the burn logged in raven-black ink: one raven guards one nest, never a thousand. 1,000 fake identities must burn 60,000 POA up front, more than any slot earns back. Each slot is an ivory token that cannot be transferred, so buying accounts gains nothing. Like yarrow from one root, an honest agent pays 60 once and earns while fakes keep paying.
